```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(devtools)
install_github("spakowiczlab/tmesig")

source("00-paths.R")
```

```{r}
x <- read.table(file = "../data/mRNA expression (FPKM_UQ).txt",
                na = "NA",
                header = TRUE)

head(x)
```

```{r}
y <- 
  x %>%
  filter(!is.na(MIR.210.5P))

dim(y)
```

```{r}
head(y)
```


```{r}
y %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = MIR.210.5P)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
summary(y$MIR.210.5P)
```

```{r}
y %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log(MIR.210.5P+1))) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/mir210-histogram.png",
       height = 3, width = 4)
```

```{r}
table(y$STUDY_ID)
```

```{r}
pcawg.files <- list.files(file.path(paths$box, "data", "pancan_pcawg_2020"), 
                          full.names = TRUE)

pcawg.files
```

```{r}
mirna <- read.table(pcawg.files[grep("data_mirna.txt", pcawg.files)],
                    header = TRUE) 

head(mirna)
```


```{r}
pm <- 
  mirna %>%
  gather(-Hugo_Symbol, key = "sampleID", value = "FPKM") %>%
  spread(key = Hugo_Symbol, value = FPKM)

pm %>%
  select(contains("mir-210")) %>%
  gather(key = "miR", value = "FPKM") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log(FPKM+1))) +
  geom_histogram(aes(fill = miR)) +
  theme_bw() 

ggsave("../figures/pcawg_mir210_histogram.png",
       height = 3, width = 4)
```

```{r}
rna <- mirna <- read.table(pcawg.files[grep("data_mrna_seq_fpkm.txt", pcawg.files)],
                    header = TRUE) 
```
